items.title: Dispatch Z-01 -> S-02 · 35 people
reasons: Zone 01 is forecast to flood first (simulated hazard 0.78 by t+3).
Shortest route that stays open in 251 of 256 futures.
S-02 still has 41 certified free seats after this group arrives.

items.title: Migrate G-0009 · S-03 -> S-04
reasons: S-03 is no longer safe at G-0009's arrival time.
S-04 is certified at 0.963 and 40 seats are reserved before the group is re-routed.
Hysteresis (keep 0.90 vs dispatch 0.95) stops groups being bounced between shelters.

items.title: Dispatch Z-03 -> S-04 · 40 people
reasons: Zone 03 has the most people still waiting (142).
Route stays open in 252 of 256 futures, including after the t+3 closure.
S-04 can take G-0009 and this group together — checked jointly, not one at a time.

items.title: Dispatch Z-02 -> S-05 · 40 people
reasons: Zone 02 sits next to the road forecast to close — waiting longer increases risk.
With 512 futures the lower bound is 0.953, above the 0.95 threshold.
Uncertain options are never sent: below 0.95 it would still be blocked.

items.title: HOLD Zone 04 · escalate to field team
reasons: S-01 water level is still rising — arrival would be unsafe in about 1 of 7 futures.
Every other shelter route crosses the closed segment.
Holding is safer than sending people on an uncertified route.
